storyline.name: Hrill
storyline.scene: d29/dawn135 Hythe East Arm quay, Hrill with Crown Reeve Elric Marden. Hrill ACCEPTED seven days Crown patrol duty d29-35 inclusive,1GP/day paid after duty plus board, no advance. SevenGP watch hiring allowance allocated, sevenpersondays board not charged yet. Employment stored on Hrill; old Edda ten days fully paid10GP preserved as previous contract. Hrill says glad to work in troop again. Marden offers hand: Then welcome, Sir Hrill. You’ll draw the same meals and stand the same watches as the rest of them. Await Hrill response/action; muster/patrol not yet played or scheduled, no new danger established. Prepare any substantial new adventure before opening it, reusing action/honor/troop preferences. Hrill20GPfullHPFreshMP8Luck3ownlongswordmailshieldbow18arrowsmaintenancekey. Greywatchreport delivered toMarden, relief arrangements pending, hearing date unfixed, no verdict/pardon. No Hanzo link established; Hrill testified Avel asked whether Hanzo declared himself, claimed acted alone. OtherPCclocks unchanged.
